data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Furnary was the name of a goddess who presided over furnaces and forges. She ensured that the fires were kept burning and the metals were transformed into useful objects. In Christianity, the name Furnary could symbolize a spiritual forge, where one's faith is tested and refined. The name Furnary carries the meaning “Furnace keeper” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Furnary usually hope their child will grow to embody furnace keeper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
